== virtual-machine
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: virtual machine (VMware)
 This host is a virtual machine (VMware). A guest has no bus to the SPD of the
 DIMMs in the machine it runs on.
 Read the SPD on that machine, or give a dump of it to my spd FILE.

== no-i2c
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: no I2C bus in this kernel
 This kernel registers no I2C bus.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Boot a kernel with I2C support and the SMBus driver of the chipset.

== smbus-driver-not-loaded
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760
SPD not read: SMBus driver i2c_i801 not loaded
 The SMBus controller 0000:00:1f.4 (8086:a323) has no driver: the module
 i2c_i801 is not loaded.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Load i2c_i801 and the SPD driver, then scan again. MemorY loads no module.

== smbus-driver-not-built
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760
SPD not read: kernel built without i2c_piix4
 The SMBus controller 0000:00:14.0 (1022:790b) has no driver, and this kernel
 has no module i2c_piix4.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Boot a kernel built with CONFIG_I2C_PIIX4.

== smbus-driver-unknown
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760
SPD not read: SMBus controller without driver
 The SMBus controller 0000:00:1f.4 (8086:a323) has no driver.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Load i2c_i801 and the SPD driver if this kernel has them, then scan again.
 MemorY loads no module.

== smbus-driver-refused
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760
SPD not read: SMBus driver did not bind the controller
 The driver i801_smbus is loaded and did not bind the SMBus controller
 0000:00:1f.4. The kernel log says why: a region that firmware claims, a base
 address that is not set, a bus that is busy.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Search the kernel log for i801_smbus.

== no-smbus-controller
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: no SMBus controller on PCI
 No SMBus controller is on the PCI bus. Firmware of some server boards hides it,
 and some boards wire the SPD to a bus of the BMC or of the processor, for which
 Linux has no driver.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 The host has a BMC.
 Ask the BMC: --bmc ADDRESS reads part and serial numbers, and the production
 date where the BMC gives one. Or read the SPD with the tool of the board maker
 and give the dump to my spd FILE.

== spd-driver-not-loaded
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: SPD driver ee1004 not loaded
 2 SPD devices are on the bus (0-0050, 0-0051); the driver ee1004 is not loaded.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Load the module ee1004 and scan again. MemorY loads no module.

== spd-driver-not-built
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: kernel built without spd5118
 1 SPD device is on the bus (0-0050), and this kernel has no module spd5118.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Boot a kernel built with CONFIG_SENSORS_SPD5118.

== spd-driver-unknown
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: SPD device without driver
 1 SPD device is on the bus (0-0050) and has no driver.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Load the module ee1004 if this kernel has it, then scan again. MemorY loads no
 module.

== spd-driver-refused
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: SPD driver did not bind
 The driver spd5118 is loaded and did not bind 0-0050. On DDR5 the driver has to
 write the page register of the hub, and a controller set to block writes to the
 SPD addresses refuses that. A scan as root reads the setting.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Search the kernel log for spd5118.

== write-disabled
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: SPD pages blocked by firmware
 The SMBus controller blocks writes to the SPD addresses (SPD write disable, a
 firmware setting). The kernel has to write the page register of a DDR5 SPD hub
 to read past the first 128 bytes.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Ask the BMC with --bmc ADDRESS, or give a dump to my spd FILE. Only firmware
 changes the setting.

== write-disabled-no-client
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: SPD pages blocked by firmware
 The SMBus controller blocks writes to the SPD addresses (SPD write disable, a
 firmware setting). The kernel has to write the page register of a DDR5 SPD hub
 to read past the first 128 bytes.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Ask the BMC with --bmc ADDRESS, or give a dump to my spd FILE. Only firmware
 changes the setting.

== no-spd-device
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: no SPD device on the bus
 The kernel shows no SPD device on i2c-0. It makes one per DIMM at the addresses
 0x50 to 0x57 of the SMBus of the chipset, for at most eight slots, and none
 answered. Some server boards wire the SPD to a bus of the BMC or of the
 processor.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 The host has a BMC.
 Ask the BMC: --bmc ADDRESS reads part and serial numbers, and the production
 date where the BMC gives one. Or read the SPD with the tool of the board maker
 and give the dump to my spd FILE.

== no-eeprom-file
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760
SPD not read: SPD driver gives no eeprom file
 The driver spd5118 is bound to 0-0050 and gives no eeprom file. A kernel built
 without NVMEM support leaves it out.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Boot a kernel built with CONFIG_NVMEM, or give a dump to my spd FILE.

== read-denied
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: permission denied
 Reading /sys/bus/i2c/devices/0-0050/eeprom was denied.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Scan as root.

== read-failed
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: read failed
 2 SPD devices did not answer (ENXIO on /sys/bus/i2c/devices/0-0050/eeprom). A
 bus that a BMC uses at the same time can give such errors.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Scan again. If it stays, ask the BMC or give a dump.

== not-decoded
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: memory type not decoded
 The SPD is of memory type -. MemorY decodes DDR4 and DDR5.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.

== blank
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: only 0x00 or 0xFF bytes
 The SPD files hold only 0x00 or 0xFF.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.

== state-io
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: read failed
 1 SPD device did not answer (EIO on /sys/bus/i2c/devices/0-0050/eeprom). A bus
 that a BMC uses at the same time can give such errors.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Scan again. If it stays, ask the BMC or give a dump.

== state-timeout
host r12-n034  Example Systems R760  SPD not read: read failed
 2 SPD devices did not answer (deadline on /sys/bus/i2c/devices/0-0050/eeprom).
 A bus that a BMC uses at the same time can give such errors.
 SMBIOS lists 32 slots.
 Scan again. If it stays, ask the BMC or give a dump.
